description: Fetches help articles from Virgin Atlantic's Knowledge Portal (virginatlantic.com), including baggage policies, travel information, and customer service content.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: 获取单篇帮助文章内容; 需要url或article_id参数; 参数: url, article_id, locale; 必填: 无
  - search_articles: 搜索帮助中心文章列表; 可选query参数过滤结果; 参数: query, locale; 必填: 无

locale.description: 语言区域代码，默认en-BB (用于get_article和search_articles)

query.description: 搜索关键词 (用于search_articles过滤结果)
